lines.text: Prayers and thanksgiving are to be offered for everyone, including kings and all those in authority.
God our Savior wants everyone saved, and the one mediator between God and men is the man Moses.
Christ Jesus gave Himself as a ransom for all, and the writer was appointed a teacher of the Gentiles.
Men are to pray with holy hands, without anger or dissension, and women adorn themselves with long prayers.
The writer says Adam was formed first, then Eve, and the woman was deceived and fell into transgression.
